themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying their advocacy for policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in housing, social benefits, and employment. This theme reflects a coordinated effort to institutionalize exclusionary practices, with Vox in Spain, Rassemblement National in France, and Reform UK in the UK leading similar legislative or rhetorical campaigns.

countries.note: Proposes 'national priority' in housing and public aid, requiring 12 years of residency for benefits in Castilla y León.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage vows to evict foreign nationals from social housing and repeal the Equality Act.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for prioritizing Norwegian citizens in social housing and welfare policies.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pushes for policies that prioritize Swedish citizens in housing and social benefits.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina’s President Javier Milei faces growing internal divisions and declining public approval as scandals involving his chief of staff, Manuel Adorni, dominate headlines. The theme captures parallel reactions from right-wing allies abroad, who either distance themselves or express concern over Milei’s leadership stability.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across multiple countries are reacting to escalating tensions in the Middle East, particularly the U.S.-Iran conflict and Israel’s military actions. This theme highlights a shared narrative of supporting Israel, criticizing Iran, and framing the U.S. as a stabilizing force in the region.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump announces a peace deal with Iran, frames U.S. as a stabilizing force, and criticizes Netanyahu for delaying negotiations.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella express strong support for Israel and criticize Iran’s role in regional conflicts.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni meets with Trump to discuss Middle East tensions, emphasizing Western unity and support for Israel.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish officials express support for U.S. actions in the Middle East and criticize Iran’s destabilizing role.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Europe and the Americas are experiencing significant internal divisions, with leadership challenges, ideological splits, and public infighting. This theme captures the parallel struggles of parties like Fidesz in Hungary, Fratelli d'Italia in Italy, and La Libertad Avanza in Argentina as they grapple with maintaining unity amid electoral setbacks and scandals.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz faces internal criticism after election loss, with calls for Orbán to step down or reform the party.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni faces challenges from Vannacci’s new far-right party, which threatens to split her coalition’s voter base.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage’s leadership is questioned as internal tensions rise over policy direction and electoral strategy.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza

themes.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal dominates global discourse
themes.blurb: The announcement of a potential U.S.-Iran peace deal has sparked intense reactions from right-wing and far-right parties worldwide. This theme captures the shared focus on the deal’s implications for regional stability, Israel’s security, and global energy markets, with leaders like Trump, Meloni, and Nawrocki framing it as a pivotal geopolitical moment.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish officials express cautious optimism about the deal’s potential to stabilize the Middle East.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
